channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Ephesians 2:8
item.description:
“For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:”

Ephesians 2:8 (KJV)

Salvation is a gift, not a wage; you could never earn it and you don't have to. Receive it by faith with empty, grateful hands.

Prayer: Father, thank You for the gift of salvation by grace through faith.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 1 Thessalonians 5:11
item.description:
“Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.”

1 Thessalonians 5:11 (KJV)

Everybody needs encouragement, including you. Don't wait to receive it — give it. Build someone up today.

Prayer: Lord, show me who needs encouragement today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: 1 Corinthians 2:9
item.description:
“But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.”

1 Corinthians 2:9 (KJV)

Your imagination has limits; God's goodness does not. What He has prepared for those who love Him is beyond eye, ear, and heart. Dream big; He is bigger.

Prayer: Father, I cannot wait to see what You have prepared.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Colossians 3:2
item.description:
“Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.”

Colossians 3:2 (KJV)

Where your heart is set determines how you see everything. Earthly things fade, but heavenly things last. Lift your focus above the temporary today.

Prayer: Lord, set my heart on things above today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Colossians 3:12
item.description:
“Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;”

Colossians 3:12 (KJV)

Just like you choose your clothes each morning, choose kindness, humility, and patience. Wear them all day.

Prayer: Father, clothe me in kindness today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Romans 12:21
item.description:
“Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.”

Romans 12:21 (KJV)

Evil wants you to fight on its terms; do not. Overcome it with good: kindness for cruelty, blessing for cursing. Good is stronger, and it wins in the end.

Prayer: God, help me overcome evil with good.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Proverbs 30:5
item.description:
“Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.”

Proverbs 30:5 (KJV)

Every word God speaks is pure, with no mixture and no mistakes. You can trust His promises completely, and He becomes a shield to those who do. Take Him at His Word today.

Prayer: Lord, I put my trust in Your pure Word today.
